Media \& Entertainment is being rebuilt around the direct relationship with the consumer and the partner. Streaming and direct\-to\-consumer platforms, advertising\-supported tiers, bundles, content licensing, royalties and participations, and platform and app\-store partnerships all generate enormous volumes of small transactions that must be billed, collected, reconciled and accounted for correctly.
